post_clip.description: A large cylindrical object (likely a tanker or pipe) is lying横 across the road at an intersection, blocking traffic lanes. This suggests a recent vehicle accident—possibly a truck overturning or cargo detachment—resulting in a hazardous obstruction. A pedestrian is seen walking near the scene, and vehicles are stopped or maneuvering around the debris, consistent with a post-collision scenario. No active collision is visible in these frames, but the presence of the overturned load strongly indicates a prior road accident.
